limitations_admitted.value: Temperature assumption per clump ignores individual core temperatures and is the largest mass uncertainty

evidence.quote: Ultimately, a caveat has to be raised about these temperature assumptions.

Assigning the same temperature to all the cores within the same clump according to its properties, although representing a reasonably good approximation, inevitably ignores the distribution of temperatures

limitations_admitted.value: Extraction is limited to compact sources and may miss more extended structures

evidence.quote: we may be actually missing possible more extended structures which are instead revealed by other literature works

evidence.loc: 5.4 Estimated physical parameters of the cores
evidence.quote: The non-deconvolved core physical diameter has been derived from the circularized FWHM of the fitted source ellipse

limitations_admitted.value: Free-free contamination may affect some cores in either direction

evidence.quote: since it is still possible that some of the positionally matched cores might actually not be significantly contaminated by the presence of local free-free emission

limitations_admitted.value: Mass accretion rates cannot be derived from these data

evidence.quote: detailed estimations of mass accretion rates cannot be performed from these data

referee_caveats_inferred: Clump L/M is used as an evolutionary clock for cores, but it is dominated by the brightest source and not independent of core mass (M_max versus L/M correlation partly built in).
Temperature is tied to clump L/M, so mass trends with L/M are partly built in; flux-only test mitigates but also scales with d^2 and uses the same grouping.

Single-pointing, filtered interferometric maps with different configurations for near and far samples; Gaussian-fit sizes are not deconvolved and are close to the beam, so mass-size slope and surface densities are resolution sensitive.
CuTEx is a modified, not clearly released code, and the 5 sigma cut was tuned by visual inspection; the catalog is not independently reproducible from the paper alone.
CMF slopes are not fitted and no statistical test (e.g. KS or slope uncertainty) is given for the shift between groups.

missing_for_reproduction: ALMAGAL continuum maps and the exact CASA imaging recipe (Sanchez-Monge+25)
Modified CuTEx code and its parameter file
Clump table with distances and L/M (Molinari+25)
Monte Carlo temperature sampling details and seeds
Binning and fit details for the mass-size relation and median trends
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: 1013 fields with 7M plus two 12m configurations in Band 6; raw MOUS data likely several TB to tens of TB, but only the continuum FITS images (about 35 arcsec FOV) are needed, of order GB; the catalog is at CDS.
reproducibility.score_reason: Catalog and many numeric results are stated, but the maps, modified CuTEx code, clump table and several fit settings come from other papers or are not given.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The paper does not state that the data are public, the modified CuTEx code is not clearly released, and key inputs (continuum maps, clump L/M and distances) are only in companion papers.

methods_papers.why: ALMAGAL data acquisition, processing pipeline and continuum map characterization
CuTEx curvature filter and Hi-GAL usage
L/M versus CH3C2H temperature calibration for the core temperature model

companion_papers.why: Clump-level properties and further core-clump correlations
Spatial distribution and mass segregation of the cores
Comparison with numerical simulations matched to ALMAGAL
